task_title: daemon pipeline executor import path resolution
task_criteria: getPipelineExecutorCandidates in src/daemon/daemon.ts resolves the pipeline executor for src/, specs/daemon.spec.dir/ and dist/ layouts; npx vitest run tests/daemon-executor-OBS-7.test.ts exits 0 with every test passing.

items.criterion: getPipelineExecutorCandidates in src/daemon/daemon.ts resolves the pipeline executor for src/, specs/daemon.spec.dir/ and dist/ layouts; npx vitest run tests/daemon-executor-OBS-7.test.ts exits 0 with every test passing.
items.detail: src/daemon/daemon.ts:32-41 defines getPipelineExecutorCandidates anchored to the module URL (default pathToFileURL(__filename)), choosing .ts/.js by the module's own extension and returning ../pipeline/executor.{ext} plus ../../pipeline.spec.dir/src/executor.{ext}. All three layouts verified on disk: src/pipeline/executor.ts (symlink -> ../../specs/pipeline.spec.dir/src/executor.ts), specs/pipeline.spec.dir/src/executor.ts, and dist/src/pipeline/executor.js. executePipeline consumes the candidates at src/daemon/daemon.ts:395-413 with an existsSync check per candidate and a thrown error when none load. Command `npx vitest run tests/daemon-executor-OBS-7.test.ts` exited 0 with output 'Test Files  1 passed (1)' and 'Tests  9 passed (9)'. [resolution 0.02; src/daemon/daemon.ts, tests/daemon-executor-OBS-7.test.ts]

items.criterion: Compiled dist output carries the same resolution logic (dist layout not stale relative to src)
items.detail: dist/src/daemon/daemon.js:28-36 contains the identical getPipelineExecutorCandidates implementation (same two candidates, same ts/js extension switch), and the passing test 'loads the compiled executor selected by the compiled daemon itself' (part of the 9/9 passing run, exit_code=0) requires the compiled daemon to resolve dist/src/pipeline/executor.js.
